value.F7_runs_this_session: 6 runs: F7 failed in 4 of them, always on the DROPPED magazine's physics (tactical or empty): it came to rest at 3.006 or 3.33 s against the 3.0 s gate, tunnelled 1.6 cm into the floor, or came to rest on the first magazine. A zero-slide control build failed the same way. In every run the spawn matched the socket within 0.005-0.006 cm, and the ammo, event order and timing passed. After the play test learned GripSlide, F12 (attach / IK) read 0.0 cm in every run.

gates.note: Not met: F7 dropped-magazine physics noise, which the grip change does not touch (see F7_runs_this_session)

gates.value: Right hand: only the index is in the guard, with its pad on the trigger. Middle, ring and pinky wrap the pistol grip under the guard. From the right side the guard opening below the index is clear, idle and mid-burst. From left-front-below the middle sits just under the guard's rear bar, and the thumb is on the grip's left side. Left hand: as in round 2, but ring and middle now touch along their length (no wood strip). The no-flash burst frames (05c) and the shoulder-aim close-ups (07b, including a wide two-hand view) show both grips while firing and aiming.
gates.threshold: only the index in the guard, fingers wrapped, no wood strip between left ring / middle

method: Right hand: slid 1.8 cm down the pistol grip (NinjaGun.GripSlide in gun space; the attach is T(-GripSlide) x HandOffset; a hand_r Two Bone IK on GunGripSlideHS with alpha GunHoldWeight), so the gun stays put. The right fingers are re-solved with a guard term and the index on the trigger face, in their own GunHoldWeight layer. The left fingers are re-solved with narrower spacing (all four, two passes). Files: solver Tools/Claude/Guns/g10b_grip_solve_r3.py, builder build_gun_grip_g10b.py (round-3 branch), probe g10b_grip_probe_game.py (05c no-flash third burst, 07b shoulder-aim close-ups, root_err with GripSlide), gun_playtest.py (F12 with GripSlide).

review_issues.right middle inside the trigger guard (0: FIXED. A real defect, confirmed in the frames and in numbers (middle 02 joint at z 2.17, inside the opening). Its highest skin forward of the grip is now z 0.62, under the bar's underside at 1.0. Before/after crops: cmp_03_*.
review_issues.index tip pressed into the front of the: REJECTED as stated. That finger was the middle; the index pad was on the trigger, about 3.5 cm behind the guard's front. The index pad now sits on the blade's face (0.18 cm), with the tip past the blade's left side.
review_issues.left fingers stiff, straight, vertical,: PARTLY REJECTED. The mesh shows the AR-01 lower handguard's right face is flat, with only the bottom corners rounded. The fingers bend at the bottom-right corner (bends 58-70 / 24-40 / 22-31 deg) and then lie flat on that face, as a real wrap on this section does. The paddle look comes from the UEFN mannequin's blocky, square-tipped fingers.
review_issues.left fingers split into two pairs (wood: FIXED. Middle-ring tips 1.67 -> 1.40 cm and joint 03 2.06 -> 1.85; the fingers touch along their length (cmp_02_left_hand_right_side_idle).
review_issues.hand hangs ~250 px below the handguard (: REJECTED; the reviewer also marked it cosmetic. The palm touches the underside (gap -0.12 cm) and the knuckles are 0.09-0.37 cm from the wood. What shows below is the UEFN hand's ~3 cm thickness: its long fingers need the palm under the wood to reach up the 4.4 cm right face.
review_issues.07 shoulder aim hides the hands: ADDRESSED with evidence, nothing to fix. New close-ups of the same shoulder-aim pose (07b: right and left hand, below, left-front-below, a wide two-hand view) show the grip.
review_issues.muzzle flash blows out the burst frames: ADDRESSED. New mid-burst frames (05c) hide the muzzle light and flash particles from the capture only. They were taken while firing (shots 9-26 of that burst); the hands keep their idle placement.

honest_notes: Play test 14/15. F7 (reloads) failed on dropped-magazine physics in 4 of 6 runs this session, including a zero-slide control build. The spawn transform matched the socket within 0.006 cm every time. The grip is not the cause, but the result is not 15/15.
The right hand now sits 1.8 cm lower on the pistol grip than the retargeted rifle clip put it. The pinky tip is at the grip's bottom edge (z -4.5; the grip bottom is -5.4).
The right fingers keep the grip pose in the reload too (layer weight GunHoldWeight). The G10c reload work should know this.
G10d (FP body) must use T(-GripSlide) x HandOffset and the same hand_r IK, or the FP hand returns to the old height.
